title: Cowboy Hat
wikitext: {{Infobox mousehat |name = Cowboy Hat |image = Cowboy Hat.png |achievement = A Complete Collection |ad = Complete the [[Museum|museum]] collection. |price = {{Price|10000}} }} The '''Cowboy Hat''' is a [[Hats|hat]] that can be purchased from the [[Abandoned House]] for {{Price|10000}} after earning the "A Complete Collection" [[Achievements|Achievement]] (complete the [[Museum|museum]] collection). It can also be obtained from [[Desert Festival#Emily's Outfit Services|Emily's outfit services]] at the [[Desert Festival]]. There is a ≈2% chance to receive the gender-neutral outfit with the Cowboy Hat. ==Notes== * The Cowboy Hat outfit also includes the [[File:Shirt208.png|24px|link=]] [[Tailoring#Shirts|Excavator Shirt]] and [[File:Farmer Pants.png|24px|link=]] [[Tailoring#Pants|Farmer Pants]] (dyed RGB value 168,111,1). ==References== Male players have 47 possible outfits (1/47 ≈ 2.13%), while female players have 48 possible ones (1/48 ≈ 2.08%). See Content\Data\MakeoverOutfits.xnb. [[wikipedia:RGB color model|RGB]] refers to "Red,Green,Blue". ==History== {{History|1.0|Introduced.}} {{History|1.6|Purchase price increased from {{Price|1000}} to {{Price|10000}}.
